stories.title: Ex-NBA player Beasley negotiating plea deal in gambling case
stories.summary: Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed.

stories.title: Brewers escape ninth-inning jam, replay drama to take World Series opener
stories.summary: The Brewers survived some late drama, including a seemingly game-ending double play that was overturned on review, to beat the Rays 3-2 in Game 1 of the World Series.

stories.title: NFL House in Paris closes ahead of street protests
stories.summary: The NFL closed its "NFL House" in Paris as the city braced for street protests with a heavy police presence and storefronts boarded up.

stories.title: Sources: Hoosiers' backfield at full strength as Martin returns
stories.summary: Indiana running back Khobie Martin, who suffered a broken forearm in the Hoosiers' season opener, is available and will play against Michigan, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Manchester City's perfect EPL start ends with Aston Villa loss
stories.summary: Manchester City suffered defeat for the first time in the Premier League this season after Nicolas Jackson's double earned Aston Villa a 2-1 victory at Villa Park.
